★★The argument★★

Content is the invitation. Community is where the capital is.

Nobody raises money from a download number. They raise it from people who know them, trust them, and stay in the room long enough to do something together.

That is what a community is, and it is the most valuable asset a capital raiser can own. It is also the reason so few have one. Building a community is slow, it takes infrastructure, and the people who try mostly end up running it out of a Facebook group.

A podcast is how you start. It is the most authentic form of content there is, which matters more every month as the internet fills with content nobody actually made. You cannot fake a real conversation, and an audience can tell.

The show earns the credibility. The credibility earns the audience. The audience becomes a community. The community is where the capital is. Most people stop after the first step and wonder why the phone does not ring.

Straight answers

I have never made a podcast and I am not sure I want to.

That is who this is built for. You are not being sold a hobby. You are being shown how a show becomes a community and how a community becomes capital, so you can decide whether that trade is worth a few hours a week.

I do not have time to run a podcast.

Then this is the session for you, because the constraint is the whole subject. Russell will show you what he actually does each week and what he does not do. If the answer is still no after 90 minutes, take the refund.

I am not a broadcaster and I do not want to be on camera.

Neither were most of the eleven hosts on the network. They are investors, CPAs, and developers. The skill being taught is having a useful conversation on the record, not performing.

Is the market not already saturated?

There are a great many podcasts. There are very few capital raisers who have turned an audience into an actual community. That second part is the scarce thing, and it is most of what the 90 minutes is about.

Can I not learn this free on YouTube?

You can learn how to start a podcast free anywhere. What is not free is the man who coached a client to a thousand member investor club telling you how it maps onto raising capital, and answering your question live.

What if I cannot attend live?

Register anyway. Every seat includes the recording. You can also send your question in advance and Russell will address it during Q&A.
